findings.title: Contract SHA mismatch in receipt
findings.detail: Receipt (NEXARA_PHASE_2B_IMPLEMENTATION_RECEIPT_V1.json) claims contract_sha='7148ef9f727d0d552fa96fc3f41ba56c44ee32ebae97abdad2e9f5835636ab76' but the actual SHA-256 of the contract file on disk is '90ca8ee4afdd352bb79f01fbf45f4f122dc315db960d31bb467e0f02f89b532b'. This breaks the evidence chain — the receipt cannot be trusted to reference the correct contract.
findings.recommendation: Recompute contract SHA-256 and update receipt's contract_sha field. Re-run shasum -a 256 on the contract file.

findings.title: MockMC routing mismatch for kind='procedural' — silent production failure
findings.detail: ExperienceLearner.record_lesson() commits with kind='procedural'. In MockMC (_LAYER_MAP), 'procedural' maps to layer='procedural'. In the real ConsolidationRules.KIND_TO_LAYER, there is NO 'procedural' key — classify_layer('procedural') returns default 'semantic'. get_lessons() queries layers=['procedural'], so in production it would find ZERO lessons. Tests pass because the mock routes differently than production. This is the exact pitfall warned about in the implementation-review skill: 'When MockMC replicates layer-mapping, cross-reference the mock's maps against the real production rules.'
findings.recommendation: Either (a) add MemoryKind.PROCEDURAL='procedural' to the enum and a 'procedural':'procedural' entry to KIND_TO_LAYER, or (b) change record_lesson to use kind='lesson' and add 'lesson':'procedural' to KIND_TO_LAYER. Then update MockMC _LAYER_MAP to match.

findings.title: Frozen tree is not committed — zero Phase 2B files in git
findings.detail: The contract claims the tree is frozen at HEAD 593f7070839c9a01ea98c3e4c39741cbdfa1fe16. However: (1) git show HEAD:src/nexara_prime/brain/preference_model.py fails with 'exists on disk, but not in commit'; (2) git ls-files returns empty for both source files; (3) git status shows all Phase 2B files as untracked (??). The 'frozen tree' has no version control — it exists only on the local filesystem.
findings.recommendation: Commit all Phase 2B files to git before claiming a frozen tree. A frozen tree must have a verifiable git commit containing all source, test, contract, and evidence artifacts.

findings.title: Protected runtime files have uncommitted changes
findings.detail: NEXARA gate rules explicitly state '3 dirty files NEVER staged: cli.py, model_router.py, runtime.py'. All three have significant uncommitted changes: cli.py (+14 lines: Chief Brain integration), model_router.py (+2: mock tier change), runtime.py (+166: model pool, routing, brain gates). These changes are outside Phase 2B scope.
findings.recommendation: Either commit these changes in a separate PR before Phase 2B, or stash them to keep the Phase 2B review boundary clean.

findings.title: consolidation_rules.py has uncommitted Phase 2B change
findings.detail: The '+2 lines' adding 'experience':'episodic' to KIND_TO_LAYER is an uncommitted modification to a tracked file. This is the only Phase 2B change touching an existing file.
findings.recommendation: Include consolidation_rules.py in the Phase 2B commit scope.

findings.title: MemoryKind enum missing 'experience' value — raw string bypasses type safety
findings.detail: ExperienceLearner uses kind='experience' (raw string) in 4 places (record_outcome, extract_patterns, rank_experiences, prune_irrelevant). The MemoryKind enum has 13 values but no EXPERIENCE='experience' member. ConsolidationRules.KIND_TO_LAYER maps the raw string 'experience' to 'episodic', bypassing the enum type-safety layer that all other kinds use.
findings.recommendation: Add MemoryKind.EXPERIENCE = 'experience' to the enum in models.py, then reference it via MemoryKind.EXPERIENCE.value in consolidation_rules.py and MemoryKind.EXPERIENCE in experience_learner.py.

findings.title: Contract method and test counts don't match actual code
findings.detail: Contract claims PREF-01 has 6 methods (actual: 8 public) and 15 tests (actual: 13 in test_preference_model.py). EXP-01 claims 6 methods (actual: 7 public) and 13 tests (actual: 11 in test_experience_learner.py + 4 isolation = 15 total, but isolation tests aren't module-specific).
findings.recommendation: Update contract method counts to match actual code, or explain counting methodology.

findings.title: Unnecessary # noqa: F401 on used import
findings.detail: experience_learner.py line 5: 'import json  # noqa: F401'. The 'json' module IS used throughout the file (json.dumps, json.loads on lines 65, 75, 110, 124, 129), so F401 would never fire. The annotation is noise.

findings.title: MockMC _LAYER_MAP has dead 'lesson' entry
findings.detail: conftest.py _LAYER_MAP includes '"lesson": "procedural"' but no code path uses kind='lesson'. record_lesson uses kind='procedural', not kind='lesson'. Dead code in test infrastructure.
findings.recommendation: Remove unused 'lesson' entry from MockMC _LAYER_MAP, or align it with the real rules (where classify_layer('lesson') would return 'semantic' by default).
